first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ, which is the most direct metric pressure facing the business. memory_91 demonstrated that in-product activation messaging improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action—this is directly addressable and lower-risk than pricing moves. While simplify_onboarding (memory_86, memory_31) also addresses the 4% onboarding completion decline, activation messaging targets the larger current problem and has proven leverage. Referral incentives and enterprise sales assist are valuable but don't address the immediate activation crisis. Promotional pricing risks margin and brand position when the core issue is engagement, not price sensitivity in this moment. Verifying memory_91 and memory_86 will confirm effect sizes and confirm whether activation messaging was properly segmented and whether onboarding simplification had lasting lift, informing prioritization if we run activation messaging this week and plan onboarding work next.
